verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voting for the Top 20 is open until 6 a.m. ET on Tuesday, March 24.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'closes at 4 a.m. MDT on March 24' (equivalent to 6 a.m. ET); R2: 'Voting remains open until 6 a.m. on Tuesday'; R3: 'until 6 a.m. Tuesday, March 24'; R5: 'closes at 6 a.m. ET'; R6: 'close at 6 am ET on Tuesday, March 24'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the voting window closes at 6 a.m. ET (or equivalent) on March 24 for Top 20.

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voting has three ways: online at AmericanIdol.com/vote, text, and social media.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Vote ... at idolvote.abc.com ... Vote via text ... social media ... Facebook, Instagram and TikTok'; R4: 'AmericanIdol.com/Vote By SMS text Commenting ... Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok'; R5: 'three ... ways ... online ... text ... social media'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently list exactly three voting methods: online (URLs match or equivalent), text, and social media.

verifications.claim: Up to 10 votes can be cast per contestant per method (online, text, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok) for American Idol 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'up to 10 votes per voting method per contestant'; R2: 'submit 10 votes each on ... Facebook, Instagram and TikTok'; R3: 'up to 10 times per contestant per platform' (lists website, text, social: FB/IG/TT)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm 10 votes per method/platform per contestant, treating online, text, and each social platform (FB, IG, TT) separately, aligning with claim's listing.

verifications.claim: The Top 14 will be revealed in the March 30 episode.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'competition will be down to a top 14'; R3: 'Top 12 ... revealed in the March 30'; R6: 'Top 12 reveal next week'
verifications.reasoning: R1 supports Top 14; R3 and R6 specify Top 12 on March 30, creating direct contradiction.

verifications.claim: Online voting for American Idol is at americanidol.com/vote.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Text voting for American Idol is by texting the contestant's assigned number to 21523.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'texted to “21523”'; R2: 'text 11 to 21523'; R3: 'Text message: 21523'; R4: 'By SMS text'; R5: 'text ... to the number “21523”'; R6: 'texting ... to 21523'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm texting contestant's number to 21523.

verifications.claim: Social media voting for American Idol uses the Official Vote Post on the official American Idol Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok accounts where the contestant's name is commented.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'comment on the pinned official voting post ... Facebook, Instagram and TikTok ... name of the contestant'; R2: 'vote on social media ... submit 10 separate comments'; R3: 'Comment the singer's name on @AmericanIdol's official voting post on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok'; R4/R5 similar.
verifications.reasoning: Sources precisely describe commenting contestant's name on official pinned voting post on FB/IG/TT.

verifications.claim: American Idol voting limits are 10 votes per contestant per method.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'up to 10 votes per voting method per contestant'; R3: 'vote up to 10 times per contestant per platform'; R5: 'up to 10 times per voting method'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported by multiple sources on vote limits per method/platform per contestant.

verifications.claim: American Idol voting eligibility requires being 16+ and located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R4: '16 years ... U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands' (for online); 'at least 18 years old and located in the U.S.' (for social media)
verifications.reasoning: Reference specifies 16+ only for online voting; social media requires 18+ and U.S. only (omits PR/VI), contradicting the claim's uniform 16+ and locations for all voting.

verifications.claim: American Idol voting generally closes at 6 a.m. ET the morning after performances.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'until 6 a.m. Tuesday' (post-Monday); R5: 'closes at 6 a.m. ET ... the following morning'; R6: 'close at 6 am ET on Tuesday, March 24' (after March 23 performance)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state general closing time as 6 a.m. ET morning after performances.

verifications.claim: The American Idol app is no longer used for voting.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'the show got rid of its app, so voting is now available only through the website, over text and via social media comments'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statement confirms app is discontinued for voting.
